1: /*
2:  * Fused Attention CUDA kernel — optimized implementation
3:  *
4:  * Computes: output = softmax(Q @ K^T / sqrt(d)) @ V
5:  * with causal masking support.
6:  *
7:  * Optimizations over baseline:
8:  * - Parallel warp+block reductions instead of serial thread-0 loops
9:  * - Vectorized dot products where possible
10:  */
11: 
12: #include <torch/extension.h>
13: #include <cuda_runtime.h>
14: #include <cuda_fp16.h>
15: #include <math.h>
16: #include <float.h>
17: 
18: template <typename scalar_t>
19: __global__ void attention_kernel(
20:     const scalar_t* __restrict__ Q,    // [B, H, N_q, D]
21:     const scalar_t* __restrict__ K,    // [B, H, N_kv, D]
22:     const scalar_t* __restrict__ V,    // [B, H, N_kv, D]
23:     scalar_t* __restrict__ output,     // [B, H, N_q, D]
24:     int q_len,
25:     int kv_len,
26:     int head_dim,
27:     int num_kv_heads,               // PATCH(attn_harden): K/V head count (== num_heads when K/V arrive expanded)
28:     float scale,
29:     bool causal
30: ) {
31:     int b = blockIdx.x;
32:     int h = blockIdx.y;
33:     int q_pos = blockIdx.z;
34: 
35:     int num_heads = gridDim.y;
36:     int q_BH_stride = q_len * head_dim;
37:     int kv_BH_stride = kv_len * head_dim;
38:     int base_q = (b * num_heads + h) * q_BH_stride + q_pos * head_dim;
39:     // PATCH(attn_harden): grouped-query attention: K/V head for query head h (identity when num_kv_heads == num_heads)
40:     int kv_h = h / (num_heads / num_kv_heads);
41:     int base_kv = (b * num_kv_heads + kv_h) * kv_BH_stride;
42:     int full_q_pos = kv_len - q_len + q_pos;
43: 
44:     extern __shared__ float smem[];
45:     float* scores = smem;  // [kv_len]
46:     // Load Q row into shared memory after scores area
47:     float* s_q = smem + kv_len;  // [head_dim]
48: 
49:     int tid = threadIdx.x;
50:     int bdim = blockDim.x;
51: 
52:     // Cooperatively load Q into shared memory
53:     for (int d = tid; d < head_dim; d += bdim) {
54:         s_q[d] = static_cast<float>(Q[base_q + d]);
55:     }
56:     __syncthreads();
57: 
58:     // Step 1: compute attention scores + local max
59:     float local_max = -FLT_MAX;
60:     for (int j = tid; j < kv_len; j += bdim) {
61:         if (causal && j > full_q_pos) {
62:             scores[j] = -FLT_MAX;
63:         } else {
64:             float dot = 0.0f;
65:             int base_k = base_kv + j * head_dim;   // PATCH(attn_harden)
66:             for (int d = 0; d < head_dim; d++) {
67:                 dot += s_q[d] * static_cast<float>(__ldg(&K[base_k + d]));
68:             }
69:             scores[j] = dot * scale;
70:         }
71:         local_max = fmaxf(local_max, scores[j]);
72:     }
73: 
74:     // Parallel max reduction (warp shuffle + shared memory)
75:     for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1)
76:         local_max = fmaxf(local_max, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, local_max, offset));
77: 
78:     // Inter-warp reduction
79:     __shared__ float warp_reduce[32];
80:     int lane = tid & 31;
81:     int warp_id = tid >> 5;
82:     int num_warps = (bdim + 31) >> 5;
83: 
84:     if (lane == 0) warp_reduce[warp_id] = local_max;
85:     __syncthreads();
86: 
87:     float global_max;
88:     if (warp_id == 0) {
89:         float val = (lane < num_warps) ? warp_reduce[lane] : -FLT_MAX;
90:         for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1)
91:             val = fmaxf(val, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, val, offset));
92:         if (lane == 0) warp_reduce[0] = val;
93:     }
94:     __syncthreads();
95:     global_max = warp_reduce[0];
96: 
97:     // Step 2: exp and local sum
98:     float local_sum = 0.0f;
99:     for (int j = tid; j < kv_len; j += bdim) {
100:         float e = expf(scores[j] - global_max);
101:         scores[j] = e;
102:         local_sum += e;
103:     }
104: 
105:     // Parallel sum reduction
106:     for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1)
107:         local_sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, local_sum, offset);
108: 
109:     // PATCH(attn_harden): every thread must have read warp_reduce[0] (global_max) before lane 0 of warp 0 overwrites it
110:     __syncthreads();
111:     if (lane == 0) warp_reduce[warp_id] = local_sum;
112:     __syncthreads();
113: 
114:     float global_sum;
115:     if (warp_id == 0) {
116:         float val = (lane < num_warps) ? warp_reduce[lane] : 0.0f;
117:         for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1)
118:             val += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, val, offset);
119:         if (lane == 0) warp_reduce[0] = val;
120:     }
121:     __syncthreads();
122:     global_sum = warp_reduce[0];
123: 
124:     // Normalize scores
125:     float inv_sum = 1.0f / global_sum;
126:     for (int j = tid; j < kv_len; j += bdim) {
127:         scores[j] *= inv_sum;
128:     }
129:     __syncthreads();
130: 
131:     // Step 3: weighted sum of V
132:     for (int d = tid; d < head_dim; d += bdim) {
133:         float acc = 0.0f;
134:         for (int j = 0; j < kv_len; j++) {
135:             int base_v = base_kv + j * head_dim;   // PATCH(attn_harden)
136:             acc += scores[j] * static_cast<float>(__ldg(&V[base_v + d]));
137:         }
138:         output[base_q + d] = static_cast<scalar_t>(acc);
139:     }
140: }
141: 
142: // ─── Host wrapper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
143: 
144: torch::Tensor agent_attention(
145:     torch::Tensor Q,      // [batch, heads, q_len, head_dim]
146:     torch::Tensor K,      // [batch, heads, kv_len, head_dim]
147:     torch::Tensor V,      // [batch, heads, kv_len, head_dim]
148:     bool causal
149: ) {
150:     // PATCH(attn_harden): the kernel indexes dense [B, H, N, D] buffers; refuse anything else instead of reading
151:     // past them. inject.py:120-122 already passes .contiguous() tensors; the checks cost nothing on the hot path.
152:     TORCH_CHECK(Q.dim() == 4 && K.dim() == 4 && V.dim() == 4, "attention: Q, K, V must be [batch, heads, len, head_dim]");
153:     TORCH_CHECK(Q.is_cuda() && K.is_cuda() && V.is_cuda(), "attention: Q, K, V must be CUDA tensors");
154:     TORCH_CHECK(Q.is_contiguous() && K.is_contiguous() && V.is_contiguous(), "attention: Q, K, V must be contiguous");
155:     TORCH_CHECK(Q.scalar_type() == K.scalar_type() && Q.scalar_type() == V.scalar_type(), "attention: dtype mismatch");
156:     int batch = Q.size(0);
157:     int heads = Q.size(1);
158:     int q_len = Q.size(2);
159:     int kv_len = K.size(2);
160:     int head_dim = Q.size(3);
161:     int kv_heads = K.size(1);
162:     TORCH_CHECK(K.size(0) == batch && V.size(0) == batch, "attention: batch mismatch");
163:     TORCH_CHECK(V.size(1) == kv_heads && V.size(2) == kv_len, "attention: K/V shape mismatch");
164:     TORCH_CHECK(K.size(3) == head_dim && V.size(3) == head_dim, "attention: head_dim mismatch");
165:     TORCH_CHECK(kv_heads > 0 && heads % kv_heads == 0, "attention: num heads must be a multiple of num kv heads");
166:     TORCH_CHECK(q_len <= kv_len, "attention: q_len must not exceed kv_len");
167: 
168:     float scale = 1.0f / sqrtf(static_cast<float>(head_dim));
169:     auto output = torch::empty_like(Q);
170:     if (batch == 0 || heads == 0 || q_len == 0) return output;
171: 
172:     dim3 grid(batch, heads, q_len);
173:     // PATCH(attn_harden): whole warps only: the reductions use full-mask __shfl_down_sync (lines 72, 87, 103, 112),
174:     // which is undefined for a partial warp (stock launched kv_len threads, e.g. 2 or 12 at prefill).
175:     int threads = min(((kv_len + 31) / 32) * 32, 256);
176:     size_t smem_size = (static_cast<size_t>(kv_len) + head_dim) * sizeof(float);
177:     TORCH_CHECK(smem_size <= 48 * 1024, "attention: kv_len ", kv_len, " needs ", smem_size,
178:                 " bytes of dynamic shared memory, above the 48 KB default");
179: 
180:     AT_DISPATCH_FLOATING_TYPES_AND2(
181:         at::ScalarType::Half, at::ScalarType::BFloat16,
182:         Q.scalar_type(), "attention", [&] {
183:             attention_kernel<scalar_t><<<grid, threads, smem_size>>>(
184:                 Q.data_ptr<scalar_t>(),
185:                 K.data_ptr<scalar_t>(),
186:                 V.data_ptr<scalar_t>(),
187:                 output.data_ptr<scalar_t>(),
188:                 q_len, kv_len, head_dim, kv_heads, scale, causal
189:             );
190:         }
191:     );
192:     // PATCH(attn_harden): surface launch errors here (asynchronous; no sync added)
193:     cudaError_t err = cudaGetLastError();
194:     TORCH_CHECK(err == cudaSuccess, "attention kernel launch failed: ", cudaGetErrorString(err));
195: 
196:     return output;
197: }

1: /*
2:  * Fused SwiGLU MLP CUDA kernel — optimized implementation
3:  *
4:  * Uses cuBLAS (via torch::matmul) for the heavy GEMM work,
5:  * then fuses the SiLU activation + elementwise multiply in-place.
6:  */
7: 
8: #include <torch/extension.h>
9: #include <cuda_runtime.h>
10: #include <cuda_fp16.h>
11: #include <math.h>
12: 
13: // In-place fused SiLU-multiply: gate[i] = silu(gate[i]) * up[i]
14: // 4 elements per thread for better ILP
15: template <typename scalar_t>
16: __global__ void fused_silu_mul_inplace_kernel(
17:     scalar_t* __restrict__ gate,         // [N] - modified in place
18:     const scalar_t* __restrict__ up,     // [N]
19:     int N
20: ) {
21:     int base_idx = (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) * 4;
22:     #pragma unroll
23:     for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
24:         int idx = base_idx + i;
25:         if (idx < N) {
26:             float g = static_cast<float>(gate[idx]);
27:             float u = static_cast<float>(up[idx]);
28:             float silu_g = g / (1.0f + expf(-g));
29:             gate[idx] = static_cast<scalar_t>(silu_g * u);
30:         }
31:     }
32: }
33: 
34: // ─── Host wrapper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
35: 
36: torch::Tensor agent_fused_mlp(
37:     torch::Tensor input,        // [batch, hidden]
38:     torch::Tensor gate_weight,  // [intermediate, hidden]
39:     torch::Tensor up_weight     // [intermediate, hidden]
40: ) {
41:     // Use torch matmul (cuBLAS) for the GEMMs
42:     auto gate_proj = torch::mm(input, gate_weight.t());
43:     auto up_proj = torch::mm(input, up_weight.t());
44: 
45:     int N = gate_proj.numel();
46: 
47:     int threads = 256;
48:     int blocks = (N + threads * 4 - 1) / (threads * 4);
49: 
50:     AT_DISPATCH_FLOATING_TYPES_AND2(
51:         at::ScalarType::Half, at::ScalarType::BFloat16,
52:         input.scalar_type(), "fused_mlp", [&] {
53:             fused_silu_mul_inplace_kernel<scalar_t><<<blocks, threads>>>(
54:                 gate_proj.data_ptr<scalar_t>(),
55:                 up_proj.data_ptr<scalar_t>(),
56:                 N
57:             );
58:         }
59:     );
60: 
61:     return gate_proj;  // modified in-place, no extra allocation
62: }

(End of file - total 62 lines)
</content>

1: /*
2:  * RMSNorm CUDA kernel — optimized implementation
3:  *
4:  * Computes: output = (x / rms(x)) * weight
5:  * where rms(x) = sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps)
6:  */
7: 
8: #include <torch/extension.h>
9: #include <cuda_runtime.h>
10: #include <cuda_fp16.h>
11: #include <math.h>
12: 
13: template <typename scalar_t>
14: __global__ __launch_bounds__(1024)
15: void rmsnorm_kernel(
16:     const scalar_t* __restrict__ input,
17:     const scalar_t* __restrict__ weight,
18:     scalar_t* __restrict__ output,
19:     int hidden_size,
20:     float eps

[analyzes attention kernel for optimization opportunities]

The attention kernel uses a large shared memory allocation: `smem_size = (kv_len + head_dim) * sizeof(float)`. For long sequences, this can exceed the 48KB limit. The kernel already checks this and fails.

The fused MLP kernel is minimal and uses cuBLAS for the heavy lifting.

The RMSNorm kernel uses a block-wide reduction with warp shuffles and shared memory.

The RoPE kernel is already optimized with fp32 angles and double-precision sincos.

The attention kernel has the most room for optimization. One opportunity is to use vectorized memory accesses for the Q, K, and V tensors when head_dim is a multiple of 4.

I will modify the attention kernel to use float4 vectorized loads for Q, K, and V when possible.
